newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia in low CPI environment - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia in low CPI environment - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the September quarter consumer price index (CPI) confirmed that Australia was in a low inflationary environment and that the country could overcome this traditional speed limit on its economy.
Continuing low inflation would reduce pressure on interest rates but wages growth consistent with low inflation was crucial, Costello said in a statement.
"The September quarter CPI outcome confirms that the Australian economy has settled into a low inflationary environment, consistent with the Reserve Bank's objective," Costello said.
"This good inflation performance suggests Australia can overcome what has in the past been a traditional speed limit on economic growth," he said.
"Continuing low inflation will reduce pressure on interest rates and provide for greater investor certainty, both of which support productive long-term investment."

"However, crucial to the realisation of these benefits will be that future wage outcomes are consistent with low inflation -- something that all in the wage-negotiating process must recognise," the treasurer said.
He noted that the September quarter's annual headline rate of inflation of 2.1 percent was the lowest result for two years.
Headline prices -- which include the irregular items that are excluded from the underlying measure -- rose 0.3 percent in the quarter, compared with 0.7 percent previously.
